display_name: 投影细节尖峰的源输入与网络层幅度追踪
description: 复用同一 E10 到 E11 的临时源复现，在首个修正 NMSE 超过100的微批中记录输入、后验基线与网络各层汇总。

data.version: Original R07 draw11 63000 source rows, L_s6300/U_s56700, original saved E11 order.
data.representation: Original source clean/received IQ, simulator Action/noise and frozen original F0 continuous features.
data.actual_training_labels: No TX labels; original simulated source physical action/noise and frozen original F0 continuous features.
data.augmentation: Original saved draw11 and epoch11 permutation, no new source synthesis.

permissions.query_use: Original L_s/U_s source rows only; no TX truth, V/OE/target inputs or target predictions.
permissions.claim_scope: Source-only layer activation magnitudes at first reproduced spike; never infer target identity, modify the running parent or select a deployment checkpoint.

checkpoint.initialization: Original source-only ProjectedPriorDetail E10/2470 model, AdamW and RNG loaded only for disposable E11 replay; no candidate is saved.
sources: Original frozen source Tri-SIG-TIME SSL F0 and original source mean/covariance.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original E10 code/config/epoch/steps and technical-only metadata, source-only smoke and saved E11 order/draw; exact original source release imported.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original E10 source L_s/U_s only, F0 continuous guidance, no TX/V/OE/target. Temporary optimizer steps cannot initialize deployment.
checkpoint.selection_rule: E10 fixed as original E11 technical boundary. Source activations captured only for highest correction record of first flagged microbatch; not model selection.

expected_artifacts: spike_trace.json if projected spike is reproduced

metric_names: Original source replay spike outcome, batch location and actual proposal/projected correction/operator; fixed threshold100.
At the first flagged microbatch, maximum record received/clean/posterior base, predicted noise, per-layer activation norm/RMS/absolute max and prior output weight stats.
Fixed checkpoint trajectory may diverge on a shared GPU; absence of a reproduced spike means no layer trace and no conclusion.

rows.purpose: Determine whether the reproduced large proposal follows a large posterior input or internal detail-network activations.
rows.seed_notes: Original E10 saved RNG, E11 order and draw11.
rows.scenario: Original L_s/U_s source only, no target.
rows.optimizer: Original AdamW state temporarily restored; original LR/branch clipping unchanged.
expected_artifacts: spike_trace.json if projected spike is reproduced

notes: First source replay observed 14/32 records above100 after25 updates; max proposal209.6703, projected189.4231, spectral operator norm7.543; actual direction was not amplified.
Record input, posterior base, predicted noise, output weights and original detail-layer norms for the same highest-error record; hooks retain tensors without changing gradient or RNG.
The rerun may follow a different floating-point trajectory and may not reproduce the spike. No target, TX, V/OE, final model, early stopping or change to the parent training.
Two targeted tests and one independent P0/P1 review passed. Actual original E10/F0 source2 smoke is first.
